message.content: Rowan discusses how Cersei represents the idea that power comes at a cost. He notes that despite achieving her goals, Cersei appears to have lost so much along the way. This includes losing her children, which Rowan suggests pushed her over the edge, leading her to embrace cruelty to secure her power. Rowan's observation highlights the complex and multifaceted nature of Cersei's character, emphasizing how her relentless pursuit of power ultimately led to significant personal losses and profound emotional isolation.
